name: Migration Bridge Architecture
description: Design the VS Code migration bridge and the import-from-existing-tools workflow. Covers VS Code extension-to-Tribunus mapping (keybindings, settings, workspace config, extensions), incremental import of projects from Cursor, Windsurf, Continue.dev, Claude Code, and other agent-IDEs, conflict resolution strategies, and rollback-on-failure guarantees.
purpose: Lower switching costs by providing automated migration tools that import configuration, workspace state, and project history from existing agent tools and VS Code-based IDEs, with safe rollback if the migration fails.
acceptanceCriteria: VS Code migration bridge specification maps all major VS Code configuration groups to Tribunus equivalents (keybindings, settings, snippets, tasks, launch configs, workspace state)
Import workflow specification covers Cursor, Windsurf, Continue.dev, Claude Code, and generic VS Code-based IDE imports
Conflict resolution strategy documents auto-merge rules, conflict triage UX, and manual resolution prompts
Rollback mechanism specification guarantees atomic migration with full undo on failure
Migration workflow specification includes pre-import validation, dry-run preview, incremental import steps, and completion report
